changes: Add a clearly marked trash button to remove the current study card after confirmation.
Select multiple decks to study their unique words together.
Reorder decks and access options for every deck from its gear menu.
Use an icon button to undo answers from the session results.
Combine Unseen only and Needs practice when choosing cards for a session.
Use the undo arrow to return to the previous card and undo its answers and score changes.
Undo is also available from the session results and after answering the current card.
Fix changelog loading on GitHub Pages.
